description: This file contains the implementation of a Read-Only Helper Data Access Object (DAO) for the Apache OFBiz entity framework. It provides methods to retrieve entity data without allowing any modifications, adhering to the read-only constraint. The class implements the GenericHelper interface and interacts with a GenericDAO to perform database queries such as find by primary key, count, and relation-based retrievals, but disables creation, updates, and deletions.

classes.name: ReadOnlyHelperDAO
classes.description: A Data Access Object providing read-only access to entity data, implementing the GenericHelper interface in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getHelperName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the helper, as provided by helperInfo.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Attempt to create a new entity record; always returns null since the DAO is read-only.

methods.name: createAll
methods.description: Attempt to create multiple new entity records; always returns null for the same reason.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue entity by primary key, performing a select operation via the genericDAO.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Retrieves a partial entity by primary key, selecting only specified fields.

methods.name: findAllByPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entities for multiple primary keys, invoking findByPrimaryKey for each.

methods.name: removeByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Attempt to remove an entity by primary key; always returns 0 since the DAO is read-only.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Performs a query based on specified conditions, returning an EntityListIterator for traversal.

methods.name: findByMultiRelation
methods.description: Retrieves entities based on a multi-relation context using the genericDAO.

methods.name: findCountByCondition
methods.description: Returns the count of entities matching specific conditions.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Attempt to update/save an entity; always returns 0 as modifications are not permitted.

methods.name: storeByCondition
methods.description: Attempt to update entities based on a condition; always returns 0.

methods.name: checkDataSource
methods.description: Validates the entity data source, ensuring correctness but not adding missing entities or fields in read-only mode.
